Name: ANTI BLUE TEAM CHRISSY
Author: isari112
Description:
It's just a very simple recolor of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17698]Chrissy[/url] npc by Seanie Dew. I did it just because I could, and I thought that maybe someone else would want to enjoy the chaos with less chaotic-looking Chrissy. Just replace the files and you'll be good, it obviously won't do anything on its own.

Also, ﻿all credit go to the original creator and all the people who helped him. All the credits are obviously the same as in the original file, and since you need to download the original file, I won't be repeating it all.
